user.title: Create fitness profile
user.description: Create the person whose fitness will be evaluated.

data.sex: Sex (optional; used only by methods requiring sex-specific reference data)

data_description.profile_name: Name used to create this person's separate Fitness profile and entities.
data_description.language: Language used for Fitness announcements, coaching and explanatory sensor attributes. The Home Assistant UI language is preselected when supported.
data_description.birth_day: Day of birth. Together with month and year it is used to calculate age for age-dependent reference methods.
data_description.birth_month: Month of birth. Used with the full date of birth for age-dependent reference calculations.
data_description.birth_year: Year of birth. Used to calculate age for age-dependent fitness reference methods.
data_description.sex: Optional biological sex input used only by scientific/reference methods that explicitly require sex-specific coefficients.

required.title: Profile inputs
required.description: Weight is required. Resting heart rate is optional and can be added later. Each field accepts either a numeric value or a compatible Home Assistant entity; entity units are normalized automatically.

data_description.weight: Body mass. Used for power-to-weight and body-mass-normalized metrics. Enter kg or choose a compatible entity; entity units are converted automatically.
data_description.resting_hr: Resting heart rate in bpm. Used for heart-rate reserve (%HRR), intensity classification and Banister TRIMP. Use a true resting-HR metric, not a workout minimum.

optional.title: Optional initial / calculable values
optional.description: Each field accepts a numeric value or entity ID. Direct values use the field's documented unit; entity values are automatically converted from their unit_of_measurement. Leave unknown fields empty.

data_description.height: Height. Optional profile context. Manual values are cm; compatible entity units are converted automatically.
data_description.max_hr: Physiological/configured maximum heart rate in bpm. Used for %HRmax, %HRR and TRIMP. Fitness does not guess this from one workout maximum.
data_description.vo2max: VO₂max in mL/kg/min. Used for cardiorespiratory comparisons and long-term evaluation. Exact supported provider entities may be autofilled.
data_description.threshold_hr: Heart-rate threshold in bpm. Used to express current and completed-workout HR relative to the configured threshold.
data_description.threshold_pace: Running threshold pace in min/km. Speed entities such as m/s or km/h are converted automatically.
data_description.threshold_power: Threshold power in watts. Used for threshold-relative power and power-to-weight evaluation. Ambiguous multiple FTP sources are not auto-selected.

live_devices.title: Live workout sensors
live_devices.description: Select the physical sensors this Fitness profile may use. Native sensors come from the enabled Bluetooth and ANT+ adapter modules. Compatible Home Assistant live devices can also be selected.

data_description.live_sensor_ids: Physical sensors discovered by Fitness. ANT+ and Bluetooth identities are merged into one device when they refer to the same sensor; ANT+ is preferred for live measurements.
data_description.live_device_ids: Optional Home Assistant devices exposing compatible live heart-rate, power, cadence, speed, distance or altitude entities.

workout_devices.title: Workout and long-term fitness source devices
workout_devices.description: Select devices providing completed workouts or long-term fitness/recovery data, such as Garmin Connect or Strava.

data.workout_device_ids: Devices providing workout / fitness history data

data_description.workout_device_ids: Devices used for completed workouts/history. Only exact supported Garmin, Strava, Polar, Hevy, Peloton and Oura adapter contracts are preselected.
data_description.detailed_strength_analysis: Parse exercise/set details, estimated 1RM and per-exercise progression when strength data is available.
data_description.workout_retention_days: Days to keep canonical Fitness workouts. Use 0 for unlimited retention.

ai.title: AI interpretation
ai.description: Home Assistant's default AI Task is selected by default. Fitness follows the current system default automatically; choose a specific AI Task or conversation agent only if you want to pin one.

data_description.ai_enabled: Enables AI interpretation of deterministic Fitness calculations. AI never defines or changes scientific sensor formulas or metadata.
data_description.ai_entity: Use Home Assistant's default AI Task to follow the system preference automatically, or pin a specific AI Task / conversation agent. If a pinned provider becomes unavailable, Fitness warns you and temporarily falls back to the system default.

feedback.title: Coaching, lights and announcements
feedback.description: Choose rooms and/or explicit light entities for five-second intensity color feedback. Every available color-capable light in the selected rooms is included automatically. You can also select notification entities, a TTS provider and media players for announcements.

data.feedback_light_ids: Additional / explicit lights for intensity feedback

data_description.feedback_light_ids: Explicit color-capable lights for workout feedback. Temporary colors are serialized and the previous state is restored.
data_description.notify_entity_ids: Notification targets for workout and evaluation messages.
data_description.tts_entity_id: TTS provider used for spoken workout announcements.
data_description.tts_media_player_ids: Media players used for spoken announcements. Explicit targets are respected according to the selected workout-room rules.
data_description.feedback_area_ids: Workout room(s) used to resolve contextual lights and compatible media-player targets.
data_description.periodic_live_announcements: When enabled, Fitness gives an ongoing spoken workout evaluation at the configured interval.
data_description.periodic_live_interval_minutes: Minutes between ongoing workout evaluations. Each one refreshes the latest workout statistics before AI/coaching is generated.

sleep_devices.title: Sleep source devices
sleep_devices.description: Select devices providing sleep and recovery data.

data_description.sleep_device_ids: Only devices with sleep data Fitness can parse are shown.

assign_live_sensor.title: New fitness sensor discovered
assign_live_sensor.description: {sensor} was discovered. Choose every Fitness user who may use this physical sensor for live workouts.

data_description.fitness_profile_ids: One physical sensor can be shared by multiple Fitness profiles.

tv_dashboard.title: Fitness TV dashboard
tv_dashboard.description: Configure the optional full-screen TV dashboard. Fitness includes its own browser audio layer for music playback and TTS ducking.

garmin_local_guide.title: Garmin local workout sync
garmin_local_guide.description: Garmin watches connect directly to Home Assistant over Bluetooth; your phone is not required and Garmin Connect can remain paired. 1) Keep the watch nearby and wait for it to appear under Local Sensors. 2) Accept the Garmin sensor and assign it to one or more Fitness profiles. 3) HA-Fitness then connects briefly, imports unseen workout FIT files, and disconnects. If the diagnostic shows Pairing required, pair the watch with the Home Assistant Bluetooth host once, then press Sync workouts now. Sync is read-only: HA-Fitness does not mark Garmin files synced, archive them, or delete them. The adapter selects Garmin GFDI V0/V1 or V2 Multi-Link from device capabilities, never from a model list. Unverified MLR-only transport is rejected with a bounded backoff instead of waiting indefinitely. Detected Garmin devices: {garmin_devices}
